prompt.hi: Ek patti ke 3 barabar hisse hain aur 2 mein rang hai, yaani 2/3. Ab har hissa 4 chhote barabar hisson mein kaat diya. Rang wale hisse ko ab kaunse fraction se bolenge?
prompt.en: A strip has 3 equal parts with 2 coloured, that is 2/3. Now every part is cut into 4 smaller equal parts. Which fraction do we call the coloured part now?

reask.hi: Jis patti ke 3 barabar hisson mein se 2 mein rang hai, uska har hissa 4 mein kaat diya; ab rang wala hissa kaunsa fraction hai?
reask.en: A strip has colour in 2 of its 3 equal parts, and each part was cut into 4; what fraction is the coloured part now?

did.hi: 2/3 ke barabar 12 hisson wala fraction banaya

why.hi: Har hissa 4 mein kata, toh kul hisse 3 × 4 = 12 hue aur rang wale 2 × 4 = 8; rang utna hi raha, isliye 2/3 = 8/12.
why.en: Every part was cut into 4, so the parts became 3 × 4 = 12 and the coloured ones 2 × 4 = 8; the colour stayed the same, so 2/3 = 8/12.

simpler.hi: Pehle socho ki kul kitne chhote hisse bane. Phir socho ki rang wala har hissa kitne chhote hisse bana.
simpler.en: First think how many small parts there are in all. Then think how many small parts each coloured part became.

reask.hi: Pehli patti ka rang wala aadha, 10 hisson wali doosri patti ke kitne hisson jitna hai?
reask.en: The coloured half of the first strip is as long as how many parts of the 10-part second strip?

hindi.hi: 10 chhote hisson wali patti mein, aadhi patti kitne hisson ki hogi?
hindi.en: In the strip of 10 small parts, how many parts make half the strip?

why.hi: rang wala aadha doosri patti ke bhi aadhe tak jaata hai, aur 10 hisson ka aadha 5 hisse hai
why.en: the coloured half reaches halfway along the second strip too, and half of 10 parts is 5 parts

whyShort.hi: 10 hisson ka aadha 5 hisse hai
whyShort.en: half of 10 parts is 5 parts

whyAlt.hi: Rang wala aadha ek bada hissa hai, par doosri patti ke hisse chhote hain. Uske 10 hisson ko do barabar dher mein baanto; ek dher aadhi patti hai.
whyAlt.en: The coloured half is one big part, but the second strip's parts are small. Split its 10 parts into two equal piles; one pile is half the strip.

simpler.hi: Pehli patti ke rang wale hisse ke theek neeche dekho, aur doosri patti ke jo hisse wahan tak aate hain, unhe gino.

prompt.hi: Nayi patti utni hi lambi hai, par 12 barabar hisson mein kati hai. Ismein kitne hisson mein rang bharen ki rang pehli patti jitna hi ho?

why.hi: 12 hisse 4 ke teen guna hain, toh rang wale 2 bhi teen guna hue: 2 × 3 = 6
why.en: 12 parts are three times 4, so the coloured 2 are tripled too: 2 × 3 = 6

whyShort.hi: 4 × 3 = 12, toh rang wale 2 × 3 = 6

whyAlt.hi: Nayi patti ke hisse pehli patti ke hisson se chhote hain. Isliye utni hi jagah rangne ke liye 2 se zyada hisse lagenge.
whyAlt.en: The new strip's parts are smaller than the first strip's. So colouring the same amount takes more than 2 parts.

simpler.hi: Pehle dekho ki pehli patti ke ek hisse ke neeche nayi patti ke kitne hisse aate hain. Phir rang wale hisson ke neeche dekho.
simpler.en: First see how many parts of the new strip sit under one part of the first. Then look under the coloured parts.

pointAlt.hi: Ruler ki tarah socho: 0 se 1 tak 8 barabar gap, aur 4 gap chalne par theek beech aata hai. Us jagah ko aadha kaho, do chauthai kaho ya chaar aathve, jagah wahi hai.
pointAlt.en: Think of a ruler: 8 equal gaps from 0 to 1, and walking 4 gaps brings you to the exact middle. Call that place a half, two quarters or four eighths, it is the same place.

simpler.en: First see how many gaps of 1/8 there are from 0 to 1/4. Then think how many such quarters 3/4 holds.

did.hi: 12 gap wali line par 1/2 se chhota mark pehchaana

why.hi: 5/12 is line par paanchve mark par hai, aur 1/2 = 6/12 chhatthe mark par, isliye 5/12 chhota hai

answerViewCaption.en: Eight of the strip's ten equal parts are coloured, that is 8/10, and that is 4/5 as well.

simpler.hi: Pehle socho ki 4/5 ko kis number se guna karein ki neeche das ho jaaye. Phir dekho ki upar wala number aathve mark se milta hai ya nahi.
simpler.en: First think what to multiply 4/5 by to get ten below. Then see whether the top number matches the eighth mark.

prompt.hi: {friend} ka kehna hai ki 3/7 aur 4/8 barabar hain, kyunki dono mein neeche ka number upar se 4 zyada hai. {friend} ki baat sahi hai, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: {friend} says 3/7 and 4/8 are equal because in both the bottom number is 4 more than the top. Is {friend} right, yes or no?

reask.hi: Kya 3/7 aur 4/8 barabar hain, haan ya nahi?
reask.en: Are 3/7 and 4/8 equal, yes or no?

did.hi: upar aur neeche ke farak wali galti pakdi

viewCaption.hi: Do ek jaise gol hain: ek saat barabar hisson mein, doosra aath mein.
viewCaption.en: Two identical circles: one in seven equal parts, the other in eight.

why.hi: 4/8 theek aadha hai, par 3/7 aadhe se kam hai, kyunki 3 ka dugna 6 hi hai, 7 nahi
why.en: 4/8 is exactly half, but 3/7 is less than half, since double 3 is only 6, not 7

whyShort.hi: 4/8 aadha hai, 3/7 aadhe se kam
whyShort.en: 4/8 is half, 3/7 is less than half

whyAlt.hi: 4/8 mein khaali hisse 4 hain aur 3/7 mein bhi 4, par 7 wale hisse bade hain, isliye 3/7 mein khaali jagah zyada hai.
whyAlt.en: 4/8 leaves 4 parts empty and 3/7 leaves 4 too, but the parts of 7 are bigger, so 3/7 leaves more empty.

answerViewCaption.hi: Line ke upar saat barabar gap hain, neeche aath. 3/7 wala mark 4/8 wale mark se pehle aata hai, isliye dono barabar nahi.
answerViewCaption.en: There are seven equal gaps above the line and eight below. The 3/7 mark comes before the 4/8 mark, so the two are not equal.

simpler.hi: Pehle dekho ki 4/8 aadhe se kitna hai. Phir socho ki 3/7 bhi theek aadha hai ya nahi.
simpler.en: First see how 4/8 compares with a half. Then think whether 3/7 is exactly half too.

viewCaption.hi: Dono patti yahan do ek jaise gol ban gayi hain: ek chaar barabar hisson mein, doosra aath mein.
viewCaption.en: Both strips have become two identical circles here: one in four equal parts, the other in eight.

say.hi: Yeh do patti ek jitni lambi hain, pehli ke 4 hisse aur doosri ke 8. Doosri ke 2 hisse milkar pehli ka 1 hissa banate hain: number alag, par patti utni hi.
say.en: These two strips are the same length, the first in 4 parts and the second in 8. Two parts of the second make one part of the first: different numbers, but just as much strip.

sayAlt.hi: Barfi ki ek patti ko 4 hisson mein kaato aur 1 lo; waisi patti ko 8 mein kaato aur 2 lo. Haath mein barfi utni hi aati hai, bas naam alag hain: 1/4 aur 2/8.
sayAlt.en: Cut a barfi strip into 4 parts and take 1; cut one like it into 8 and take 2. You hold the same barfi, only the names differ: 1/4 and 2/8.

simpler.hi: Doosri patti ke do chhote hisse, pehli patti ke ek bade hisse jitne hain. Isliye number alag hon, phir bhi fraction barabar ho sakte hain.
simpler.en: Two small parts of the second strip are as long as one big part of the first. So the numbers can differ and the fractions still be equal.

prompt.hi: Teen fraction suno: 3/9, 4/12 aur 5/12. Inmein se kitne fraction 1/3 ke barabar hain?
prompt.en: Listen to three fractions: 3/9, 4/12 and 5/12. How many of them equal 1/3?

reask.hi: 1/3 ke barabar kitne fraction hain, 3/9, 4/12 aur 5/12 mein se?
reask.en: How many of 3/9, 4/12 and 5/12 equal 1/3?

viewCaption.hi: Teeno patti yahan teen ek jaise gol ban gayi hain: pehla nau barabar hisson mein, aur baaki dono baarah barabar hisson mein.
viewCaption.en: The three strips have become three identical circles here: the first in nine equal parts, and the other two in twelve equal parts each.

why.hi: 1/3 ko 3 se guna karke 3/9 aur 4 se guna karke 4/12 banta hai; 5/12 nahi, isliye 2
why.en: 1/3 times 3 on both is 3/9 and times 4 is 4/12; 5/12 is not, so 2

whyShort.hi: 3/9 aur 4/12 barabar hain, 5/12 nahi
whyShort.en: 3/9 and 4/12 are equal, 5/12 is not

whyAlt.hi: 1/3 mein neeche wala number upar wale ka teen guna hai; har fraction mein yahi dekho.
whyAlt.en: In 1/3 the bottom number is three times the top; look for that in each fraction.

simpler.hi: Har fraction mein dekho ki neeche wala number upar wale ka theek teen guna hai ya nahi.
simpler.en: In each fraction see whether the bottom number is exactly three times the top.

remediation.move: 1/2 and 2/3 each have a bottom one more than the top, yet 2/3 is past a half → a fixed gap between top and bottom does not keep the amount → only one multiplier for both does

viewCaption.hi: Dono patti yahan ek number line par hain: line ke upar do barabar gap, neeche teen, aur dono ke mark alag jagah par hain.
viewCaption.en: Both strips are on one number line here: two equal gaps above the line, three below, and their marks are at different places.

say.hi: Pehli patti 2 hisson mein, doosri 3 mein, aur rang 1/2 aur 2/3 hai. Dono mein neeche wala number upar se 1 zyada hai, phir bhi 2/3 mein rang zyada hai.
say.en: The first strip is in 2 parts, the second in 3, and the colour is 1/2 and 2/3. In both the bottom number is 1 more than the top, yet 2/3 has more colour.

sayAlt.hi: Do ek jaisi roti lo: ek ke 2 hisson mein se 1 lo, doosri ke 3 mein se 2. Doosri baar zyada roti milti hai, jabki dono baar neeche wala number upar se 1 hi zyada tha.
sayAlt.en: Take two identical rotis: 1 of the first's 2 parts, 2 of the second's 3. The second time you get more roti, though both times the bottom number was just 1 more than the top.

simpler.hi: 1/2 aadha hai, 2/3 aadhe se zyada. Dono mein neeche wala upar se 1 hi zyada hai, phir bhi dono barabar nahi.
simpler.en: 1/2 is half, 2/3 more than half. In both the bottom is just 1 more than the top, yet the two are not equal.

prompt.hi: 2/5 ke barabar fraction ka upar 4 ho, toh neeche kya hoga?
prompt.en: If a fraction equal to 2/5 has 4 on top, what goes below?

reask.hi: Upar 4 ho, toh 2/5 ke barabar fraction ka neeche wala number kya hoga?
reask.en: With 4 on top, what is the bottom number of the fraction equal to 2/5?

viewCaption.hi: Is gol ko yahan ek patti mein khola hai: paanch barabar hisse, do mein rang.
viewCaption.en: This circle is opened out into a strip here: five equal parts, two coloured.

why.hi: upar 2 × 2 = 4 hua, toh neeche bhi 5 × 2 = 10; 2 jodkar 7 nahi
why.en: top 2 × 2 = 4, so bottom 5 × 2 = 10, not 5 + 2 = 7

whyShort.hi: upar 2 se guna hua, toh neeche bhi 2 se
whyShort.en: top times 2, so bottom times 2 too

whyAlt.hi: 2/5 ki patti ka har hissa 2 mein kaato: rang wale 2 hisse 4 bante hain, aur kul 5 hisse 10.
whyAlt.en: Cut each part of the 2/5 strip in 2: the 2 coloured parts become 4, and the 5 parts in all become 10.

answerViewCaption.hi: Dono patti yahan do ek jitne gol ban gaye hain: 2/5 wala paanch barabar hisson mein, do mein rang; 4/10 wala das mein, chaar mein rang.
answerViewCaption.en: The two strips have become two same-size circles here: the 2/5 one in five equal parts, two coloured; the 4/10 one in ten, four coloured.

simpler.hi: Pehle dekho ki 2/5 ka upar wala number kis number se guna hokar 4 banta hai. Phir neeche wale ke saath bhi wahi karo.
simpler.en: First see what number turns the top of 2/5 into 4. Then do the same to the bottom number.

covered.hi: Alag number wale fraction bhi barabar ho sakte hain: line par dono ka mark ek ho, toh barabar.
covered.en: Fractions with different numbers can still be equal: if both land on one mark of the line, they are equal.
